notes: PlusTech's UPLIFT (original scene 27, state 2: setup 0x0326ff, cards 0x032a8c drawn by 0x02f710, level window 0x032865 drawn by 0x030bdb, questions and notices 0x032ca8 and 0x032788). Opened from the PlusTech menu (data/ui/plustech.json), which EXIT goes back to. The cards are SELL CHIP's (data/ui/chip_shop.json, the same layout with uplift_tex): the player's CHIPs in stock under the names they were given; with none, none and back to PlusTech.

confirm on a CHIP opens the level window (the card slides aside, the panel grows and the frames pop open as SELL CHIP's dialog does); a CHIP already at level_max asks maxed first (YES chosen) and opens it to look at only. left/right choose a level from the CHIP's own up to level_max (sys 3); the fire control shows at the level chosen, the bar 2711 grows bar_step a level from bar_at, and the price is the record's price at the new level less the price at the old (0x02f3d4), red when the money will not do. confirm on a new level: poor, or the uplift question (NO chosen); YES pays (sys 27), raises the CHIP's level in the stock and thanks. cancel closes the window (sys 8).
The help line shows the CHIP's description (0x1fae90), the way out's (0x1fb010) on EXIT and how to choose a level (0x1fb014) in the window.
The cancel hint's gap after the B button is the researcher's reading of 0x06ded3's last argument (0x1a).

rows.notes: A port addition: the fire control as rows in a taller panel. The window, preview and stats box grow by grow canvas units with their tops raise higher, keeping window_caps, preview_caps and box_caps rows of their art whole and stretching the middle (the stats box's from its empty box_plain rows). Rows start rows_top below the stats box art's top; each is row_height tall with a separator (the art's line rows) at its foot, a divider block divider_height tall with the art's divider rows. Range rows show the reticle's size, washed in its preview colour (tint_alpha: wash, left strip). Positions are canvas units from the stats box art's left; ink is a label's ink top and bottom below its row's top. Digits are the number font at digit_scale, right-aligned.

help_text.dialog: Hold Left/Right to accelerate; D-pad + left stick doubles the speed. LB/RB: -10/+10. LT/RT: minimum/maximum. Click or drag the level meter. Press A/START to confirm.
